title: Trump brushes off NSA internal network outage: ‘it’s like that when you’re big and powerful’ – live
en: President’s words could be seen to run counter to NSA’s claim of ‘scheduled routine maintenance’ causing temporary issue Sign up for US Breaking News email Abdul El-Sayed , the Democratic-Senator elect from Michigan, said today that he would be happy to work with the Trump administration to pass one of his tentpole policy agenda items – Medicare For All. “Everybody’s like, ‘ah well, you’d work with Donald Trump to get Medicare For All?’. I’m like hell yeah, because the point for me is Medicare For All. I don’t care who puts their name on it. I need to go back and talk to Michiganders, and I need to know that our service made their lives easier,” he said at the Atlantic Summit in Washington DC. Continue reading...
